svg.title: Amora Florals Entity Relationship Diagram
svg.desc: Crow's Foot logical ERD of the Amora Florals e-commerce MySQL schema: users, orders, order items, deliveries, products, product sizes, categories, and inventory items.
svg.text: Logical ERD (Crow's Foot) · Implemented Laravel / MySQL schema · E-commerce flower shop

g.text: PK = Primary Key · FK = Foreign Key · UK = Unique · * = nullable

svg.text: Source of truth: Laravel migrations in amora_web. products.category is a free-text field — it is not a foreign key to CATEGORIES.
